_comment: Project-scoped MCP server. Copy to the WORKSPACE ROOT as `.mcp.json` (commit it so every session in the workspace gets the graph tools). Requires the orchestrator daemon running (started by the SessionStart hook). The MCP server is a thin stdio proxy over the daemon on ORCH_PORT (default 8787).
_comment_auth: Optional: set ORCH_TOKEN to the same bearer token the daemon expects (env ORCH_TOKEN or <BASE>/token) so the proxy can call /mcp + write endpoints when auth is enabled. Leave unset when no token is configured (the default).

env._ORCH_TOKEN_hint: set ORCH_TOKEN here only if the daemon has auth enabled
